title: NarraSpace: Multimodal Scene-Grounded Evidence for Picture-Description Dementia Classification
abstract: arXiv:2610.28616v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Picture-description dementia classification uses a shared visual scene, but a transcript-level prediction alone does not identify the scene evidence underlying its inputs. NarraSpace links words and speech times to named picture elements and retrieves utterances for predefined scene events. Narrative-spatial descriptors summarize coverage and temporal organization. A frozen language model contrasts each event's text under examples from Alzheimer's disease and healthy-control training participants, alongside transcript surprisal and coverage measurements. Retained source records link event scores to their source utterances, speech intervals, and lexical matches. translated_title: NarraSpace：面向图片描述型痴呆症分类的基于场景的多模态证据
translated_abstract: 图片描述型痴呆症分类使用共享的视觉场景，但仅基于转录文本的预测无法识别其输入背后的场景证据。NarraSpace 将词语和语音时间与命名的图片元素关联起来，并检索预定义场景事件对应的语句。叙事-空间描述符总结了覆盖范围与时间组织情况。一个冻结的语言模型参照来自阿尔茨海默病患者和健康对照组训练参与者的示例来对比每个事件的文本，同时结合转录文本的惊讶度与覆盖度测量。保留的源记录将事件分数与其源语句、语音区间和词汇匹配相联系。在“通过自发言语识别阿尔茨海默病痴呆”基准的官方48名参与者测试集上，一个固定的支持向量分类器在五十个随机种子上取得了80.88%±2.56%的平均准确率；平均概率方法达到81.25%的准确率和91.32%的曲线下面积。
tldr: NarraSpace通过将语音内容与图片场景元素关联并提供可溯源的场景证据，实现了兼具高准确率（约81%）与可解释性的痴呆症图片描述分类。
en_tdlr: NarraSpace grounds picture-description dementia classification in traceable multimodal scene evidence, achieving about 81% accuracy with interpretable, source-linked predictions.
